description: Hand-written Q&A test set over the two sample documents. 'answer_keys' are exact strings that a correct answer (and the gold chunk) must contain. Cases marked 'unanswerable' must produce the refusal response.

questions.question: What is the wingspan of an Aurora Sparrow?
What is the mean clutch size of the Aurora Sparrow, and how many nests was it measured over?
questions.reference_answer: A mean of 4.1 eggs across 212 monitored nests.

questions.question: How many days does incubation last, and which parent incubates?
What was the estimated Aurora Sparrow population in the 2022 survey?
questions.reference_answer: About 180,000 mature individuals, down 18 percent from 2012.

questions.question: What percentage of prey items delivered to Aurora Sparrow nestlings are crane-fly larvae?
How large is the home office allowance at Northwind Logistics and when must it be claimed?
questions.reference_answer: A one-time allowance of 650 dollars, claimable in the first 90 days of remote work.

questions.question: What are the core hours in the Northwind remote work policy?
questions.reference_answer: 10:00 to 16:00 in the employee's registered time zone.

questions.question: How many working days per year may a Northwind employee work from another country?
questions.reference_answer: Up to 20 working days per calendar year, with written approval 21 days in advance.
